items.source: Abstract implementation of the InterruptibleBatchPreparedStatementSetter interface, combining the check for available values and setting of those into a single callback method AbstractInterruptibleBatchPreparedStatementSetter.setValuesIfAvailable(PreparedStatement, int).
items.translation: `InterruptibleBatchPreparedStatementSetter` 接口的抽象实现，将检查可用值和设置这些值的操作合并为单个回调方法 AbstractInterruptibleBatchPreparedStatementSetter.setValuesIfAvailable(PreparedStatement, int)。

items.source: Extension of the BatchPreparedStatementSetter interface, adding a batch exhaustion check.
items.translation: 扩展 `BatchPreparedStatementSetter` 接口，并添加批量耗尽检查。

items.source:
Issue multiple update statements on a single PreparedStatement,
using batch updates and a BatchPreparedStatementSetter to set values.
items.translation: 在单个 PreparedStatement 上发出多个更新语句，使用批量更新和 BatchPreparedStatementSetter 来设置值。
`org.springframework.jdbc.core` 包中 `BatchPreparedStatementSetter` 的用法
`org.springframework.jdbc.core.support` 包中 `BatchPreparedStatementSetter` 的用法

items.source:
Provides the core JDBC framework, based on JdbcTemplate
and its associated callback interfaces and helper objects.
items.translation: 提供基于 JdbcTemplate 及其相关回调接口和辅助对象的 JDBC 核心框架。
